hypotheses.name: VWAP band breakout
hypotheses.tagline: Follow the band break, no target, four-day horizon. The deep dive's answer to what H-002 was actually trading.
notes: The direction is FOLLOW, not fade. Tested on identical bars, thresholds and holds, follow beat fade in 79 of 100 paired cells — 25 of 25 on ETH 4h and XAUUSD 1h. H-002's own blind walk-forward already agreed: it picks MODE_BREAK in 100 of 140 folds and MODE_FADE in 4. H-002 is named after a trade it does not make.

A fixed target was destroying the payoff. Average R rose monotonically with reward:risk to the edge of every grid tried. Removing the target entirely moved XAUUSD 1h from +0.155R to +0.684R per trade. The shape is one winner in nine carried a long way, and a target cuts exactly the trades that pay.
The session-close exit was too early. A four-day horizon beats it. H-002 closes at the session boundary and gives the move back.
It survives its own null. The identical 375-cell search on phase-randomised markets found 0 hits in 1,125 cells across three seeds; its fastest route to 60% pass was 30.8 days against the real 12.9.

Fewer, larger positions are faster. A single configuration reaches 66.6% pass in 21.0 days; a ten-deep book of the same signal takes 31.6 days. Ten correlated positions at 0.50% risk put 5% at risk against a 3% daily cap, and 12.8% of accounts die on the daily limit alone.

Not yet at the goal. The in-sample 61.9% pass in 12.9 days did NOT survive blind quarterly reselection — best blind is 66.6% in 21.0 days. Session and relative-volume filters are being tested now, with 'no filter' inside the grid so the selector can decline them.

pine.text:
// H-027 — VWAP BAND BREAKOUT, the five-setting book. Signals only, no orders.
//
// Paste into TradingView: Pine Editor -> new indicator -> paste -> Add to chart.
// Built for XAUUSD 1h, floor 30 / top 5, 2% risk — 59.8% of accounts pass in 21.7 expected days (band 16.8–31.4), 0.93 trades/day.
//
// WHAT THIS IS. The strategy as it is actually traded: FIVE configurations of
// the same rule running side by side, each risking a fifth of the account. It is
// an INDICATOR - it marks the bar a setting fires on, draws the stop that
// setting would use, and counts what happened. It places no orders and prints no
// profit, because a Pine strategy's profit factor would end up compared with
// this project's, and the two are not comparable: another vendor's volume on a
// volume-weighted rule, different fills, no costs, no blind re-selection.
//
// THE RULE, for one setting:
//   * VWAP anchored to the UTC day; sigma is the volume-weighted spread of price
//     about it.
//   * z = (close - vwap) / sigma, on the CLOSED bar.
//   * long when z >= threshold, short when z <= -threshold.
//   * fill at the NEXT bar's open. No target. Stop at (stop x sigma) measured on
//     the signal bar. Exit at the horizon if the stop never trades.
//   * optional UTC session window and minimum relative volume.
//   * ONE POSITION AT A TIME PER SETTING. A setting already in a trade ignores
//     its own signals until it is out - which is why a label here means a trade
//     and not just a bar where the condition held.
//
// WHY FIVE. One setting takes 0.15 trades a day: two or three inside a whole
// evaluation, so the account resolves on luck whichever way it goes. Five give
// the same pass rate on six times the trades and blow up less often.
//
// WHAT WILL NOT MATCH THE BACKTEST, and none of it is a bug: TradingView's feed
// is a different vendor with different volume, and this rule is volume-weighted;
// the backtest refuses to trade bars that never traded, which TradingView does
// not draw at all; and the backtest charges a measured spread on both sides
// while nothing here is charged anything.
//
// THE SETTINGS EXPIRE. They were ranked on the twelve months to 2026-08-30
// and are traded unchanged for one quarter. Re-rank on 2026-12-01.

//@version=5
indicator("H-027 VWAP band breakout — 5-setting book", shorttitle="H-027 x5",
     overlay=true, max_bars_back=1000)

// ---- the five settings ----------------------------------------------------
grp1 = "Setting 1"
grp2 = "Setting 2"
grp3 = "Setting 3"
grp4 = "Setting 4"
grp5 = "Setting 5"

on1  = input.bool(true, "on", inline="a", group=grp1)
thr1 = input.float(1, "threshold σ", inline="a", group=grp1)
st1  = input.float(3, "stop σ", inline="b", group=grp1)
hd1  = input.int(384, "hold bars", inline="b", group=grp1)
lo1  = input.int(0, "UTC from", inline="c", group=grp1)
hi1  = input.int(0, "to (equal = all day)", inline="c", group=grp1)
rv1  = input.float(0, "min rel. volume", inline="d", group=grp1)

on2  = input.bool(true, "on", inline="a", group=grp2)
thr2 = input.float(1.5, "threshold σ", inline="a", group=grp2)
st2  = input.float(4, "stop σ", inline="b", group=grp2)
hd2  = input.int(384, "hold bars", inline="b", group=grp2)
lo2  = input.int(0, "UTC from", inline="c", group=grp2)
hi2  = input.int(0, "to (equal = all day)", inline="c", group=grp2)
rv2  = input.float(1, "min rel. volume", inline="d", group=grp2)

on3  = input.bool(true, "on", inline="a", group=grp3)
thr3 = input.float(0.5, "threshold σ", inline="a", group=grp3)
st3  = input.float(3, "stop σ", inline="b", group=grp3)
hd3  = input.int(384, "hold bars", inline="b", group=grp3)
lo3  = input.int(0, "UTC from", inline="c", group=grp3)
hi3  = input.int(0, "to (equal = all day)", inline="c", group=grp3)
rv3  = input.float(1, "min rel. volume", inline="d", group=grp3)

on4  = input.bool(true, "on", inline="a", group=grp4)
thr4 = input.float(0.75, "threshold σ", inline="a", group=grp4)
st4  = input.float(4, "stop σ", inline="b", group=grp4)
hd4  = input.int(384, "hold bars", inline="b", group=grp4)
lo4  = input.int(7, "UTC from", inline="c", group=grp4)
hi4  = input.int(16, "to (equal = all day)", inline="c", group=grp4)
rv4  = input.float(1, "min rel. volume", inline="d", group=grp4)

on5  = input.bool(true, "on", inline="a", group=grp5)
thr5 = input.float(1.5, "threshold σ", inline="a", group=grp5)
st5  = input.float(4, "stop σ", inline="b", group=grp5)
hd5  = input.int(384, "hold bars", inline="b", group=grp5)
lo5  = input.int(0, "UTC from", inline="c", group=grp5)
hi5  = input.int(0, "to (equal = all day)", inline="c", group=grp5)
rv5  = input.float(0, "min rel. volume", inline="d", group=grp5)

// ---- display --------------------------------------------------------------
gD = "Display"
showLabels = input.bool(true, "BUY / SELL labels", group=gD)
colorBars  = input.bool(true, "Colour the signal candle", group=gD)
showEntry  = input.bool(true, "Mark the entry bar (next open)", group=gD)
showExit   = input.bool(true, "Mark where a trade closes", group=gD)
showStops  = input.bool(true, "Draw the stops of open trades", group=gD)
showStats  = input.bool(true, "Count trades on this chart", group=gD)
bandOf     = input.int(1, "Draw the bands of setting #", minval=1, maxval=5, group=gD)
rvolLen    = input.int(480, "Relative-volume baseline, bars", minval=20, group=gD)

// ---- anchored VWAP and its sigma, shared by all five ----------------------
utcDay  = math.floor(time / 86400000)
newSess = na(utcDay[1]) or utcDay != utcDay[1]

var float pv = 0.0
var float vv = 0.0
var float p2v = 0.0
var float lastV = na

vRaw = nz(volume, 0.0)
v = vRaw > 0 ? vRaw : nz(lastV, 1.0)
if vRaw > 0
    lastV := vRaw

tp = (high + low + close) / 3.0
if newSess
    pv  := 0.0
    vv  := 0.0
    p2v := 0.0
pv  := pv + tp * v
vv  := vv + v
p2v := p2v + tp * tp * v

vwap  = vv > 0 ? pv / vv : na
varr  = vv > 0 ? p2v / vv - vwap * vwap : na
sigma = math.sqrt(math.max(nz(varr), 0.0))
sigOk = not na(vwap) and sigma > vwap * 1e-6      // the kernel's SD_EPS_FRAC
z     = sigOk ? (close - vwap) / sigma : na

hh       = hour(time, "UTC")
rvolBase = ta.sma(vRaw, rvolLen)[1]   // shifted: never judge a bar on its own volume
rvol     = rvolBase > 0 ? vRaw / rvolBase : 0.0

// ---- per-setting state ----------------------------------------------------
var pDir  = array.new_int(5, 0)
var pStop = array.new_float(5, na)
var pEnt  = array.new_float(5, na)
var pRisk = array.new_float(5, na)
var pBars = array.new_int(5, 0)
var pend  = array.new_int(5, 0)

var int   nTrades = 0
var int   nWins   = 0
var float sumR    = 0.0
var int   sumHold = 0
var int   barsIn  = 0

thrA = array.from(thr1, thr2, thr3, thr4, thr5)
stA  = array.from(st1, st2, st3, st4, st5)
hdA  = array.from(hd1, hd2, hd3, hd4, hd5)
loA  = array.from(lo1, lo2, lo3, lo4, lo5)
hiA  = array.from(hi1, hi2, hi3, hi4, hi5)
rvA  = array.from(rv1, rv2, rv3, rv4, rv5)
onA  = array.from(on1, on2, on3, on4, on5)

nOpenL  = 0
nOpenS  = 0
nEnterL = 0
nEnterS = 0
nExit   = 0
nSigL   = 0
nSigS   = 0

for i = 0 to 4
    if array.get(onA, i)
        // 1. manage an open trade
        if array.get(pDir, i) != 0
            array.set(pBars, i, array.get(pBars, i) + 1)
            dir  = array.get(pDir, i)
            stop = array.get(pStop, i)
            hitStop = dir == 1 ? low <= stop : high >= stop
            timeout = array.get(pBars, i) >= array.get(hdA, i)
            if hitStop or timeout
                // a stop the bar GAPPED past fills at the open, not at the level
                gapped = (dir == 1 and open < stop) or (dir == -1 and open > stop)
                exitPx = hitStop ? (gapped ? open : stop) : close
                risk = array.get(pRisk, i)
                rM = risk > 0 ? (exitPx - array.get(pEnt, i)) * dir / risk : 0.0
                nTrades := nTrades + 1
                nWins   := nWins + (rM > 0 ? 1 : 0)
                sumR    := sumR + rM
                sumHold := sumHold + array.get(pBars, i)
                nExit   := nExit + 1
                array.set(pDir, i, 0)
                array.set(pStop, i, na)
                array.set(pBars, i, 0)

        // 2. fill what this setting queued on the previous bar
        if array.get(pDir, i) == 0 and array.get(pend, i) != 0
            side = array.get(pend, i)
            risk = array.get(stA, i) * nz(sigma[1])
            if risk > 0
                array.set(pDir, i, side)
                array.set(pEnt, i, open)
                array.set(pRisk, i, risk)
                array.set(pStop, i, side == 1 ? open - risk : open + risk)
                array.set(pBars, i, 0)
                if side == 1
                    nEnterL := nEnterL + 1
                else
                    nEnterS := nEnterS + 1
        array.set(pend, i, 0)

        // 3. decide on this closed bar
        if array.get(pDir, i) == 0 and sigOk
            lo_ = array.get(loA, i)
            hi_ = array.get(hiA, i)
            inSess = lo_ == hi_ ? true : lo_ < hi_ ? (hh >= lo_ and hh < hi_) : (hh >= lo_ or hh < hi_)
            rvOk = array.get(rvA, i) <= 0.0 or rvol >= array.get(rvA, i)
            t = array.get(thrA, i)
            if inSess and rvOk
                if z >= t
                    array.set(pend, i, 1)
                    nSigL := nSigL + 1
                else if z <= -t
                    array.set(pend, i, -1)
                    nSigS := nSigS + 1

        if array.get(pDir, i) == 1
            nOpenL := nOpenL + 1
        else if array.get(pDir, i) == -1
            nOpenS := nOpenS + 1

if nOpenL + nOpenS > 0
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

// ---- drawing --------------------------------------------------------------
bThr = array.get(thrA, bandOf - 1)
plot(vwap, "VWAP (UTC day)", color=color.new(color.orange, 0), linewidth=2)
pUp = plot(sigOk ? vwap + bThr * sigma : na, "Upper band", color=color.new(color.teal, 40))
pDn = plot(sigOk ? vwap - bThr * sigma : na, "Lower band", color=color.new(color.teal, 40))
fill(pUp, pDn, color=color.new(color.teal, 95), title="Band")

// One label per BAR, not per setting: three settings firing together is one
// thing to look at.
sigL = nSigL > 0
sigS = nSigS > 0
plotshape(showLabels and sigL, title="BUY", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar,
     color=color.new(color.teal, 0), textcolor=color.white, text="BUY", size=size.small)
plotshape(showLabels and sigS, title="SELL", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar,
     color=color.new(color.red, 0), textcolor=color.white, text="SELL", size=size.small)
barcolor(colorBars and sigL ? color.new(color.teal, 0) :
   colorBars and sigS ? color.new(color.red, 0) : na, title="Signal candle")
plotshape(showEntry and nEnterL > 0, title="Entry, long", style=shape.triangleup,
     location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.teal, 45), size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showEntry and nEnterS > 0, title="Entry, short", style=shape.triangledown,
     location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red, 45), size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showExit and nExit > 0, title="Exit", style=shape.xcross,
     location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.gray, 20), size=size.tiny)

plot(showStops and array.get(pDir, 0) != 0 ? array.get(pStop, 0) : na, "Stop 1",
     color=color.new(color.red, 30), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showStops and array.get(pDir, 1) != 0 ? array.get(pStop, 1) : na, "Stop 2",
     color=color.new(color.red, 45), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showStops and array.get(pDir, 2) != 0 ? array.get(pStop, 2) : na, "Stop 3",
     color=color.new(color.red, 60), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showStops and array.get(pDir, 3) != 0 ? array.get(pStop, 3) : na, "Stop 4",
     color=color.new(color.red, 70), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showStops and array.get(pDir, 4) != 0 ? array.get(pStop, 4) : na, "Stop 5",
     color=color.new(color.red, 80), style=plot.style_linebr)

bgcolor(nOpenL > nOpenS ? color.new(color.teal, 88) :
   nOpenS > nOpenL ? color.new(color.red, 88) : na, title="Book net long / short")

// ---- the count, on the chart ---------------------------------------------
var float firstTime = na
if na(firstTime)
    firstTime := time

var table stats = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, border_width=1,
     frame_width=1, frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 60))
if showStats and barstate.islast
    spanDays = math.max((time - firstTime) / 86400000.0, 1.0)
    bg = color.new(color.black, 20)
    hdr = color.new(color.blue, 40)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 0, "H-027 book here", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=hdr, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 0, "5 settings", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=hdr, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 1, "trades", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 1, str.tostring(nTrades), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 2, "per day", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 2, str.tostring(nTrades * 1.0 / spanDays, "#.##"), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 3, "win rate", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 3, nTrades > 0 ? str.tostring(nWins * 100.0 / nTrades, "#.#") + "%" : "—", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 4, "avg R", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 4, nTrades > 0 ? str.tostring(sumR / nTrades * 1.0, "+#.###") : "—", text_color=sumR > 0 ? color.teal : color.red, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 5, "avg hold, bars", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 5, nTrades > 0 ? str.tostring(sumHold * 1.0 / nTrades, "#.#") : "—", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 6, "open now", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 6, str.tostring(nOpenL) + " long / " + str.tostring(nOpenS) + " short", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 0, 7, "risk each", text_color=color.silver, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)
    table.cell(stats, 1, 7, "0.4% of 2%", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=bg, text_size=size.small)

alertcondition(sigL, "H-027 long signal", "H-027: a setting went long")
alertcondition(sigS, "H-027 short signal", "H-027: a setting went short")
alertcondition(sigL or sigS, "H-027 any signal", "H-027: new signal")
pine.defaults_from: XAUUSD 1h, floor 30 / top 5, 2% risk — 59.8% of accounts pass in 21.7 expected days (band 16.8–31.4), 0.93 trades/day

studies.title: Exit study — how wide should the stop be?
studies.note:
Same entries, same costs. Only the stop changes.
Today's stop is half of one bar wide, so noise kills the trade. A wider stop wins more often but takes the same number of days.

studies.title: Does the gold rule work anywhere else?
studies.note:
The traded rule - wide stop, five settings, floor 30 / top 5 - run unchanged on every market in the universe, scored at 2% risk under a 1-step 2% target.
It ports to ETHUSDT 1h and partly to SOL 1h and GBPUSD 4h. Silver 1h, BTC 1h, WTI 4h and two FX cells lose to their own null.

studies.title: Fewer trades, better trades — does it help?
studies.note:
Trade less, trade better: a higher entry bar, and only one trade per move.
It does not help. Same days, fewer accounts pass.

noise_floor.note: six information-free gates on gold, 2% risk, full blind walk-forward

chosen.name: VWAP band breakout — gold 1h, five settings
caveats: The 21.7-day band (16.8-31.4) overlaps the measured luck zone (13.3-26.5 expected days). The edge beats its null; the SPEED has not been shown to differ from noise.
H-027's kernel has never been checked against a second engine. That check has caught three real bugs in this repo.
The blind selector does not choose this stop width by itself - it was forced and then measured. Fixing what the selector optimises is open work.
